provenance: Assistant-generated preliminary binary content judgments; not independently human validated.
scope: All approved saved article texts considered; unlisted approved IDs judged nonrelevant per intent. Synthetic farm duplicates are nonrelevant.
selection: Corpus-informed development queries frozen before the original ranking outputs; not a held-out benchmark. Relevant sets unchanged for final experiments.

queries.intent: Explanations of AI methods, models, applications or AI research-company systems. Exclude general biographies, investment profiles, general universities and technology-risk essays.
Venture-capital firms whose saved text describes investment in software or internet businesses. Exclude companies merely receiving funding and magazines reporting on investment.
Neutrino properties/discovery and experiments dedicated to detecting neutrinos. Exclude general particle physics or dark-matter laboratories without dedicated neutrino detection in the saved text.
Mathematical graph definitions, graph constructions and connectivity of graphs. Exclude knowledge-graph websites and general programming languages.
Human viral diseases, human-disease-causing virus families/species and viral outbreaks. Exclude bacterial conditions, bacteriophage taxonomy, general vaccines and primarily social/economic effects.
Clinical blood disorders, bleeding collections and clotting disorders. Exclude infectious diseases where bleeding is one symptom and general tissue definitions.
World Cup competitions, qualification, draws/seeding, finals and officiating arrangements. Exclude player biographies, national-team profiles, video games and unrelated FIFA awards.
Women footballers, women's football structures and awards specifically for women. Exclude predominantly men's football awards, clubs, players and tournaments.
Diplomatic forums, bilateral relations and negotiated international treaties. Exclude country profiles, domestic parties, military campaign narratives and regional geography.

State governing arrangements, constitutional country profiles, public regulatory institutions, political parties and colonial administration. Exclude diplomacy, cultural/geographic regions, party newspapers, and conflicts without an administrative-system focus.
